module.purpose: Provides commit-phase host effect operations for React's fiber reconciler, wrapping host config mutations (mount, update, text, hide/show, placement, removal, hydration, singletons) with error capture and dev fiber context.
module.summary: This module exposes a collection of exported functions that apply host-specific mutations during the commit phase of React reconciliation. It delegates to low-level host config primitives imported from ReactFiberConfig, and in development mode runs them within a fiber context for debugging. All exported callers catch exceptions and route them to captureCommitPhaseError. Internal helpers determine host parents (including fragment instances and singletons), locate host siblings for insertion ordering, and recursively insert or append placement nodes into containers or parent instances. It supports both mutation and non-mutation (immutable) rendering paths and feature-flagged fragment refs.
module.businessContext: Core part of React's reconciler; responsible for actual DOM/host mutations. Failure causes UI not updating, hydration errors, or commit-phase crashes.

detail.signature: function insertOrAppendPlacementNode(node: Fiber, before: ?Fiber, parent: ?Container, parentFragmentInstances: ?Array<FragmentInstanceType>): void
preconditions: node must be a valid Fiber with a known tag (HostComponent, HostText, HostPortal, HostSingleton, or other).
parent must be a valid DOM container or null if deferring insertion.
If before is non-null, parent must also be non-null.
postconditions: All HostComponent and HostText nodes reachable from 'node' are inserted into 'parent' via appendChild or insertBefore.
HostPortal nodes are skipped — their children handle their own insertions.
HostSingleton nodes may become the parent for their deeper children if they are scope parents.
invariants: Each host node is inserted exactly once per call path.
Sibling order is preserved during traversal.
fragment instance tracking is only performed when enableFragmentRefs is true.
edgeCases: If node is a HostPortal, traversal stops and children are not processed here.
If parentFragmentInstances is null and enableFragmentRefs is true, child insertion still proceeds without fragment context.
If node.child is null, no recursive traversal occurs.
stateMutations: DOM container state via appendChild or insertBefore
parentFragmentInstances array when passed by reference
detail.summary: Recursively inserts a fiber node and its host children into the parent DOM container, preserving sibling order via the optional 'before' reference and tracking fragment instances when enabled.

units.name: commitPlacement

detail.name: commitPlacement
detail.signature: function commitPlacement(finishedWork: Fiber, parentFragmentInstances: null | Array<Instance>, hostParent: null | Instance)
preconditions: finishedWork must be a valid Fiber representing the node being committed.
parentFragmentInstances may be null or a non-empty array of fragment instances; its contents are used when collecting fragment instances.
When supportsMutation is true, a host parent fiber must be discoverable via traversal; otherwise an error is thrown.
postconditions: If supportsMutation is false and enableFragmentRefs is true, the finishedWork node is committed to all collected parentFragmentInstances via commitImmutablePlacementNodeToFragmentInstances.
If supportsMutation is true, the finishedWork node is inserted or appended into its host parent according to the parent fiber's tag (HostSingleton, HostComponent, HostRoot, or HostPortal).
When the host parent is a HostComponent with the ContentReset flag, its text content is reset before insertion and the flag is cleared.
invariants: When supportsMutation is false, the function always returns after handling fragment refs (if enabled) without throwing.
When supportsMutation is true, hostParentFiber is guaranteed non-null; otherwise an Error is thrown.
The before sibling is determined by getHostSibling(finishedWork) before any insertion occurs.
edgeCases: When supportsMutation is false: no host parent traversal is performed; fragment instances are optionally mutated and the function returns early.
When hostParentFiber is null (supportsMutation true): throws an Error describing a likely React bug.
When hostParentFiber.tag is HostSingleton and supportsSingletons is false: falls through to the HostComponent case.
stateMutations: Mutates hostParentFiber.flags by clearing the ContentReset bit when applicable.
May mutate DOM instances via calls to resetTextContent, insertOrAppendPlacementNode, insertOrAppendPlacementNodeIntoContainer, or commitImmutablePlacementNodeToFragmentInstances.
detail.summary: Commits the placement of a finishedWork Fiber into its host parent, handling singleton acquisition, fragment instance collection, and delegation to host-specific insertion or append logic depending on the parent fiber's tag.

specLiterals.value: 'Expected to find a host parent. This error is likely caused by a bug ' + 'in React. Please file an issue.'
specLiterals.role: Error message surfaced when hostParentFiber is null while supportsMutation is true.

preconditions: finishedWork is a Fiber with a tag property
parentFragmentInstances is null or an Array<FragmentInstanceType>
postconditions: If enableFragmentRefs is false, function returns immediately with no side effects
If finishedWork is a host component or supported singleton, commitNewChildToFragmentInstances is invoked and function returns
Function always returns undefined (void)
edgeCases: enableFragmentRefs disabled: early return
finishedWork.tag HostComponent or HostSingleton: delegates to commitNewChildToFragmentInstances
finishedWork.tag HostPortal: enters else-if branch (further behavior not shown)
detail.summary: When fragment refs are enabled, registers host component or host singleton fibers as children of the given fragment instances; otherwise performs no operation.
